open_points.subject: sign_out_staff
open_points.text: - sign_out_staff: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST reach its persisted records by calling get_staff_session and update_staff_sessions of the StaffAccessRepository that staff_access of that transaction returns.
open_points.other_text: - sign_out_staff: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST address exactly the session the actor context names, and reject a missing, already revoked or expired session through the concealed authentication boundary rather than reporting a successful sign-out. Persisted records are frozen, so the revocation MUST replace that session with the imported revise_staff_session, passing the one utc_now instant as revoked_at, and MUST NOT assign to the record it read. It MUST append exactly one audit whose intent the imported build_staff_logout_audit_intent builds from the account of that session, then return the revoked session.
open_points.question: Must the dependency boundary also require get_staff so the StaffAccount needed by build_staff_logout_audit_intent can be loaded, or must the audit requirement be changed to avoid requiring an account?
